description:
Navigate to the 'Reflections' (Mirror Image) activity in GCompris and solve the puzzle. 

1. From the main menu, find the Puzzle or Math category.
2. Open the 'Reflections' activity (icon showing a butterfly or grid with a reflection line).
3. A pattern is shown on one side of the axis. Use the mouse to paint the corresponding grid cells on the other side to create a symmetrical reflection.
4. When the puzzle is solved (success animation appears), take a screenshot of the completed state.
5. Save the screenshot to '/home/ga/mirror_solved.png'.
